title: Global Spectral Theory of Everything — Version 3: Scope, Structural Status, and Operational Falsifiers
public_pdf_location: Zenodo record (not stored in this repository)
release_character: Version 3 is a synthesis/scope/status PDF, not a full research archive.
non_claims: Does not claim a complete or 100% Theory of Everything.
Does not claim the neutrino mass ordering (A4) is solved at the local level.
Does not claim a complete proof of the Yang-Mills mass gap (companion proof is a candidate).
Not a phenomenological replacement for the Standard Model or QCD.

claims.claim: Fundamental excitation operator shows intermediate (pseudo-integrable) level-spacing statistics between Poisson and GOE; universal GOE chaos is not obtained at the fundamental level and is not restored by increasing N or coupling.
claims.command: cd rmt && python scaling_tests.py   (GPU);   python3 scripts/v3_smoke_tests/run_rmt_smoke.py   (CPU sanity)
claims.expected_output: Spacing-ratio <r> for TOE operator in window approx (0.386, 0.530), mean approx 0.43, between Poisson approx 0.386 and GOE approx 0.531.
claims.limitations: Full sweep needs CuPy/CUDA; formal audit (residuals, multi-seed error bars, unfolding/finite-size) pending — see RMT_NUMERICAL_AUDIT_PLAN.md. The 'r' here is the spacing-ratio statistic, not a neutrino mass ratio.

claims.claim: Lattice mass gap equals the distance from the real coupling axis to the dominant Stokes curve of the partition function (Stokes-RG correspondence).
claims.command: Read theory/toe_v4_CMP_submission.pdf; rigorous engine in companion repo.
claims.expected_output: Manuscript distinguishes the unconditionally-proved correspondence from consequences conditional on the mass-gap programme.
claims.limitations: Repository holds manuscript and exploratory scripts, not the rigorous proof engine; some scripts require GPU and are outside the minimal smoke set.

claims.claim: Rigorous lattice-gauge mathematics (Yang-Mills mass-gap candidate proof, Fisher zeros, Stokes concentration) underpins the Stokes-RG machinery.
claims.expected_output: Independent rigorous results; mass-gap proof is a candidate (W5 and large-field Gribov open).
claims.limitations: Not reproduced from within this repository; repositories linked only via Stokes/Fisher-zero machinery.

claims.claim: Neutrino mass ordering status is layered: (a) local construction open — Majorana scale free, ordering not a local theorem; (b) minimal Majorana branch favors Normal Ordering, model-selection not forced; (c) global-spectral/swampland argument convergently favors Normal Ordering, conjectural.
claims.command: None that derives the ordering; exploratory scripts illustrate the model-selection branch only.
claims.expected_output: No script outputs the ordering as a theorem; status is conceptual / model-selection / global-QG.
claims.limitations: Open empirical boundary, not a result; A4/ordering is not claimed solved. Resolution rests on experiment (JUNO, DUNE, cosmology/DESI). Inverted ordering would falsify the predictive branch and the global-spectral argument, not the entire local framework.

claims.claim: Internal leads recorded for honesty only, not used as final claims.
claims.limitations: Earlier neutrino mass-ratio 'inverted-ordering exclusion' argument retracted as non-robust; earlier internal mechanism routes to force the ordering tried and abandoned. None is a result.
